summary: A club agrees to replace borrowed decorations that never made it home from an event.
realLife: The Mojave Desert club voted to replace two missing decorations belonging to the Victorville club. Louro and Kolar offered donations (September 28, 2019).
inGame: needs: the lender, the missing property, the replacement decision and any payment.

turns.what: A member returns them to the lending club.
turns.pulledBy: The organizers obtain replacements the lender accepts.
turns.writesBack: The two clubs close the obligation.

turns.what: The treasurer keeps the pledge separate from cash on hand.
turns.pulledBy: A donor has pledged help but has not paid.
turns.writesBack: The club still owes the lender a replacement.
